title: Sentinel Deployment Targets and Activation Thresholds
content:
Sentinel Managed Security tiers differ in how long agent deployment is planned to take and in how much of the endpoint commitment must be reporting before monitoring is switched on.

- **Deployment target**: the target business days from deployment start to activation (whole business days).
- **Activation threshold**: the share of the contracted endpoints that must report healthy agents before monitoring is activated (percent).

| Sentinel tier | Deployment target (business days) | Activation threshold (percent of contracted endpoints) |
|---|---|---|
| Sentinel EDR Essentials | 5 | 80 |
| Sentinel MDR Standard | 10 | 90 |
| Sentinel MDR Advanced | 10 | 90 |
| Sentinel MDR Complete | 15 | 90 |
| Sentinel XDR Premier | 20 | 95 |
| Sentinel XDR Enterprise | 30 | 95 |

## Illustrations (hypothetical endpoint counts)

| Tier | Contracted endpoints | Healthy agents needed | 
|---|---|---|
| Sentinel EDR Essentials | 50 | 40 (80 percent of 50) |
| Sentinel MDR Complete | 200 | 180 (90 percent of 200) |
| Sentinel XDR Enterprise | 400 | 380 (95 percent of 400) |

The deployment target is counted in business days, while the activation threshold is a share of the contracted endpoints, not of the endpoints installed so far.
